premise: Peach enters Sparkle Theater, where she can step through magic curtains on stage posters to transform into a 'Peach-formation' and star in that play's story. The dark sorceress Madame Grape has invaded the theater with Darkle power; Peach must clear every floor's plays, defeat Grape's minion bosses, rescue the captive Sparklas (Theet stars), and confront Grape herself.

entryGate.note: Nintendo Switch has no system-level achievement/trophy system. Valid Pantheon candidate.
entryGate.resolvedMode: genesis — Switch exclusive, no version on any other platform, so no native list exists anywhere to port from.

campaignStructure.formationCount: 10 selectable formations x 3 acts each = 30 main story levels. High confidence, corroborated across 3 independent scout sources.
campaignStructure.note: Exact stage titles corroborated by 2 third-party wikis/guides, not cross-checked against an official Nintendo source — spot-check wording if used verbatim in trophy copy.

bosses.name: Spotlion
bosses.location: End of 4F (5F has no floor boss of its own)

bosses.name: Madame Grape — final boss, stage "It's Showtime, Grape!"
bosses.location: Basement, after clearing all 10 Basement 'Dark' acts and rescuing all 10 Sparklas
bosses.detail: Two-phase fight: Phase 1 as Radiant Peach vs. Grape; Grape transforms into giant 'Grape the Great'; Phase 2 as Super Radiant Peach (power granted by the Theets) to finish her off.

actionRehearsals.description: 5 bonus timed score-attack stages, separate from the 30 story levels and 5 bosses: Swordfighter, Dashing Thief, Cowgirl, Kung Fu, Mighty. Taking damage ends the attempt.
actionRehearsals.grading: Bronze/Silver/Gold score-based medal per rehearsal. Gold rewards a unique exclusive dress (Starry, Heart, Geometric, Checkered, Scaly respectively) + 60 coins. Silver 30 coins, Bronze 10 coins.
actionRehearsals.trackable: Score and medal rank shown on the rehearsal results/select screen.
actionRehearsals.confidence: high for structure/existence; medium for exact score thresholds (some numbers, e.g. Cowgirl/Mighty gold cutoffs, were ambiguous across sources)

campaignStructure.totalLevels: 40 total: 30 main story levels + 5 boss stages + 5 Action Rehearsal stages. Confidence: medium (cross-checked but not from an official source).
campaignStructure.ending: After defeating Madame Grape, Peach restores the theater with Radiant/Sparkle power, gets her crown back, and takes a final bow before an audience as credits roll. High confidence.

postGame.bossRematches: Boss portraits appear on each floor after the credits; each of the 5 bosses (including Grape) offers 3 optional challenges (e.g. no-damage clears), each worth 1 Sparkle Gem the first time completed — 15 gems total. Medium confidence.
postGame.hiddenTheets: A post-game hide-and-seek activity (talk to a 'Ninja Sparkla' on 1F) to find hidden Theet characters in level replays, said to reward a Secret Dress on completion. EXACT COUNT IS CONTRADICTORY: one guide headlines '70 total' but its own stated per-level breakdown only sums to ~46, and a separate source suggests ~16. No confirmed in-game counter was found for this activity. Confidence: low. Do not build a 'collect all Theets' trophy on an unverified number — see checkpoint flag.
postGame.decorations: 15 purchasable Sparkle Theater decorations (3 per floor, 1F-5F, basement excluded), bought with leftover Sparkle Gems post-game. Single low-confidence source.
postGame.postGameOutfits: Collecting all 235 Sparkle Gems unlocks a Special Dress + Special Ribbon for purchase. After beating the story, Radiant/Grape-themed dresses and ribbons also become purchasable (500 coins each). Medium confidence.

sparkleGems.count: 235 total: 220 from the 30 main story levels (each formation's 3 acts give 10 + 7 + 5 gems = 22 per formation x 10 formations = 220) + 15 from post-game boss-rematch challenges.
sparkleGems.trackable: Per-level gem count shown on the results screen and when re-selecting a level from the Theater Lobby. No confirmed single aggregate 'X/235' counter across the whole game.
sparkleGems.confidence: medium — the 10/7/5 per-act breakdown and 220 total are corroborated by 2 independent sources; the exact boss-unlock gem thresholds per floor are unverified/contradictory and should not be used in trophy text.

ribbons.count: 30 total — one per main story level, from a 'Ribboner' Theet NPC. 1st-act ribbon grants a new Peach dress, 2nd-act a new Stella ribbon design, 3rd/finale-act an upgraded dress + ribbon.
ribbons.trackable: Per-level ribbon status checkable by re-selecting the level from the Theater Lobby or via the pause menu inside a level. Missed Ribboner encounters can reportedly also be bought later from the Floor 1 Shopkeep.

albumPhotos.count: 37 total: 30 unlocked in the main story (collect every gem in a level, then talk to the Pictioneer), 7 more added post-game (one per boss-rematch completion + a final Peach & Stella photo).
albumPhotos.trackable: Stored in the Collection menu (Photo Album).

outfits.count: Reported as 72 total (40 Peach dress designs + 32 Stella ribbon designs) by one source; a separate figure from the same guide describes an 84-item 'Collection' menu (13 ensembles, 53 songs, 18 movies) that does not clearly reconcile with the 72 figure.
outfits.trackable: Collection menu from the Main Menu.
outfits.confidence: low — single source, internally inconsistent. Do not hardcode an outfit total in trophy text.

hiddenPoseSpotlights.count: 76 across all levels (15/13/12/16/9/11 by floor 1F-BF), interactive props rewarding coins and occasionally gems.

coins.description: Spendable currency from levels, enemies, balloons, rehearsals. Not a finite collectible.

systems.difficultyModes: None. Only accessibility aid is the 'Heart Charm' item (raises health from 5 to 8 hearts). No difficulty toggle affects any trophy-relevant requirement.
systems.multiplayer: Single-player only. A claimed 'shared Joy-Con' co-op-adjacent feature is unconfirmed and likely not a real distinct mode — excluded from consideration.
systems.rng: No randomized mechanics identified — deterministic, authored levels and rehearsal patterns.
systems.missables: No confirmed permanently missable content. All 30 story levels remain freely replayable via the Theater Lobby before and after story completion; gems/ribbons can be mopped up on repeat visits.
systems.aggregateCompletion: No source confirms a single in-game aggregate 'percent complete' stat anywhere (pause menu, save select, or main menu). Completion is only checkable per-category: per-level gem counts, ribbon status, Collection menu (outfits/photos), rehearsal medal ranks. IMPORTANT for trophy design — a 'reach 100% completion' trophy cannot cite a single stat; it must instead be built from fully maxing the checkable per-category screens (Rule 1/2 concern).

dlc: None found. No paid or free post-launch content additions since the March 2024 launch.
versionDifferences: Switch exclusive, single simultaneous worldwide release. No cross-platform concerns. Minor cosmetic-only regional differences (box art, font) found, no gameplay differences.

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved — treat as unverified. Recommend excluding a numeric 'collect all Theets' trophy; at most a light-touch 'find one' style trophy if used at all.

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved — do not reference specific gem-threshold numbers in trophy text.

gaps: No confirmed aggregate 100%-completion stat exists anywhere in the game's UI — this rules out a single 'reach X% completion' trophy citing one number.
No confirmed in-game counter for Hidden Theets or Hidden Pose Spotlights beyond per-level/community tracking.
Exact score thresholds for Cowgirl and Mighty Action Rehearsal Gold rank are approximate/unclear.
Ribbon and outfit totals rest on guide sources not cross-checked against an official Nintendo reference.
